about: Hand-kept proper titles (D-159). Key: our film id. Value: the title to show. It wins over TMDB's and, like TMDB's, replaces only a title the sinima writes in capitals; the film's id and page address stay as they are. For a film TMDB can't match yet. "the-four": Funke Akindele's The Four (full title The Four: No One Fights Alone, opens 11 Dec 2026, FilmOne), which Filmhouse lists as "THE FOUR"; Chime chose "The Four" on 19 Nov 2026.
